open_points.subject: compose_flow_version
open_points.other_text: - compose_flow_version: [FIELD_ASSIGNMENT] Each constant becomes a StoredValue of value carriage with the declared value_schema and disclosure class, value_digest the content_identity of its bytes and value_id the content_identity of its StoredValueContent, its bytes stored with put_value_bytes, and a FlowConstant naming that value_id.
open_points.question: Must the bytes first be wrapped in an IdentitySubject such as BytesContent, or must content_identity accept bytes directly?

open_points.subject: prove_version phase 6 fan-in
open_points.text: 2 constants by to_node then to_port, the port exists and is an input port of a node, never a flow output, of value carriage, the constant's declared value_schema equals the port's stored schema (M21: its value_schema text for a one port, the canonical array schema with it as items for a many port) — composition already refused a value that does not fit its declared schema, so no separate value check runs here;
open_points.other_text: phase 6 fan-in by to_node then to_port: every input port of every node and every flow output has at least one edge or constant, a port with a constant has no other constant and no edge, and no two edges that can both deliver end at one port, two edges being unable to both deliver only when both are guarded on the same guard port of the same source node with different guard values.
open_points.question: Can a constant satisfy fan-in for a flow output, or are constants forbidden from targeting flow outputs?
